title: sequences.json contract
description: Structural contract for asic/<module>/Verification/simulation-plan/sequences.json — the sequence roster, the one part of the plan both consumers read: simulation compiles a <module>_<name>_seq class per entry, and power-analysis resolves power-scenarios.json's sequence_ref against these names and builds the env member m_<agent>_agent from the agent. It is its own file for that reason: a stage should not go stale on an edit to a part of the plan it cannot see.
